== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (14 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|strip steak]]
* 1 ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], minced
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] flat-leaf [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] soaked mesquite wood chips
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]

== Special equipment ==
* 4 ½ pounds charcoal briquets
* A few sheets of newspaper

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steak with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and freshly ground black pepper and press on the herbs. Bring to room temperature.
#Put charcoal in the top compartment of a large chimney.
#Moisten newspaper with vegetable oil. Wad up and place under charcoal compartment. Light and wait 15 minutes.
#Once coals have heated, spread out evenly in the bottom of a [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Toss in mesquite chips.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] steak over the hottest part of the grill for 1 ½ minutes. Rotate 90° and cook for another 1 ½ minutes. Flip and repeat this process on the other side.
#Move steak to a cooler part of the grill and cook, turning often, until desired [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry#Doneness|doneness]] (140°F for medium rare, 155°F for medium, 165°F for toast).
#Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. 
#[[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] thinly across the grain on a bias. Serve warm.

steps.text: Brush steak with extra-virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and freshly ground black pepper and press on the herbs. Bring to room temperature.
Put charcoal in the top compartment of a large chimney.
Moisten newspaper with vegetable oil. Wad up and place under charcoal compartment. Light and wait 15 minutes.
Once coals have heated, spread out evenly in the bottom of a grill. Toss in mesquite chips.
Grill steak over the hottest part of the grill for 1 ½ minutes. Rotate 90° and cook for another 1 ½ minutes. Flip and repeat this process on the other side.
Move steak to a cooler part of the grill and cook, turning often, until desired doneness (140°F for medium rare, 155°F for medium, 165°F for toast).
Remove and let rest for 7 minutes.
Slice thinly across the grain on a bias. Serve warm.
